subject: general
question: An aeroplane covers a certain distance at a speed 510 km/h in 3 h. To cover the same distance in 10(1)/(5) h, it must fly at a speed of:
solution:
**Given:**

An airplane covers a certain distance at a speed of 510 km/h in 3 h

To cover the same distance in 10(1)/(5) h

**Concept: **

Use of the formula Speed = Distance / Time

**Solution:**

Distance = Speed x Time

⇒ 510 km/h x 3 h = 1530 km

Speed to cover the same distance in 10(1)/(5) h

⇒ 1530/51/5 = 1530 × (5/51) = 150 km/h

**Therefore, it must fly at a speed of 150 km/h.**
